question: Which of the following transports products of photosynthesis from the leaves to the other parts of the plant?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Phloem**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **vascular tissue in plants that carries food is called phloem.**
 
• The many storage organs receive the **food molecules that the leaves have created. such as fruits, stems, and roots.**
 
• **The phloem carries nutrients from the leaves to the roots.**
 
• **A plant component called phloem consists of companion cells, sieve tubes, phloem fibres, and phloem parenchyma cells.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Sclerenchyma**

 
 
• **​It is a kind of supporting tissue that often consists of dead cells with walls that have been heavily thickened with lignin.**
 
• The mature sections of the plant are where it is primarily found.
 
 
 
• **Xylem**
 
 
• **​The Greek word "xylon," which means wood, is where the term "xylem" comes from.**
 
• The **term xylem was created by Carl Nägeli. **The vascular tissue known as the xylem is found in plants and is largely responsible for moving water and nutrients from the roots to the stem and leaves.
 
• **They also give the plants mechanical strength.**
 
 
 
• **Collenchyma**
 
 
• **​Two cellular structures called parenchyma and collenchyma make up the majority of plant tissues.**
 
• **Collenchyma cells** are live cells, just like** parenchyma cells. **They are made of cellulose and water, **which aids in the maintenance of the plant's morphology.**
